title: Admissible characterization in delay equations and robustness of exponential dichotomies against small-delay perturbations
summary: Robustness of exponential dichotomies against small-delay perturbations presents a fundamental obstacle: the lack of an effective admissible characterization in nonautonomous delay equations. Considerable efforts have been devoted to obtaining such a characterization for differential equations in Banach spaces. However, even unlike ordinary differential equations, the variation of constants formula for delay equations requires extending the phase space to a space of discontinuous functions, and the dependence on the past states leads to another challenge in establishing exponential dichotomy…
